title: OpenAI ships a voice mode that can interrupt itself mid-sentence
summary: The update lets the assistant stop talking when it realizes it was wrong and correct course, without the user cutting in. Rolling out to paid tiers this week.

title: Google puts Gemini inside Android's keyboard for every app
summary: Gboard now rewrites, summarizes and translates text in any app without copy-paste. Free on Pixel first, other Android phones over the next month.

title: A 3B open model now beats last year's GPT-4 on coding benchmarks
summary: The model runs on a laptop with 8GB of RAM. Weights are Apache 2.0. Benchmarks show it ahead on HumanEval and within a point on MBPP.

title: Startup raises $40M to build AI for insurance claims
summary: Series B led by a growth fund. No product details beyond 'automating claims'.
